name: ONS UK
freeEvidence: Official ONS developer hub states API is open and unrestricted with no API keys; content is Open Government Licence v3.0 except where stated. Attribute ONS and preserve dataset-specific restrictions.

name: SEC EDGAR
freeEvidence: Official SEC FAQ states government-created content and EDGAR public filing content are free to access and reuse; JSON API requires no authentication/key. Identify APIClaw and its public contact in User-Agent and respect fair-access limits.

name: CDC
freeEvidence: Official US data catalog lists CDC Open Data API with CC0 licence. Public SODA JSON read requires no app token. This reads one aggregate mortality statistic; no patient-level or restricted information.

name: EPA
freeEvidence: Official EPA publishes public Envirofacts REST data service for external applications. Government web content is public-domain unless third-party restrictions are stated. One public environmental-site record is requested.
